mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, it is 49 degrees with clear skies at City Hall, and the waxing crescent moon will be visible tonight as temperatures drop to an overnight low of 34 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has updated its zoning and sign ordinance and encourages residents to use the interactive online map to check their specific zoning district. Additionally, voters are reminded to check their assigned polling location ahead of time at the My Vote Wisconsin website, as there are four locations now serving the city.

There is plenty to do in our community, including live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow or catch some live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow as well.

The Verona Police Department reported an incident from this past Thursday involving the arrest of a school bus driver for operating while impaired. No students were injured during the incident, and the department is currently investigating a report that the bus may have struck a traffic sign.
Today's flavor of the day is Oreo Reese's Cheesecake, which you can enjoy at the restaurant until they close at 10:30 PM tonight.
